title: AlphaNIST: Emergent Assembly Skills from Binary Task Rewards
abstract: The NIST Assembly Task Board #1 remains a challenging benchmark for learning-based methods in robotic manipulation. Over short horizons, it demands precise, contact-rich control of small, tight-fitting parts. Over long horizons, it requires recovery and coordination across extended action sequences. Demonstrations, task decomposition, and dense progress rewards have enabled research advances by providing guidance on how to assemble. But how much of the strategy must be specified? The progression from AlphaGo to AlphaGo Zero showed that RL at scale can discover superhuman strategies without prescribing how to win. AlphaNIST asks whether a sparse binary task reward and task diversity admitted by this task-agnostic reward can similarly let a robot discover how to assemble. In simulation, we train a single policy from scratch across all 20 assembly tasks on the NIST Assembly Task Board #1, reaching 98.2% overall training success without demonstrations, progress shaping, scripted primitives, or per-task tuning. The framework also trains policies to complete ten assembly pairs in a single episode without a prescribed order, with task success rewarded only when all ten pairs are simultaneously complete. The learned policies discover dexterous and planning-like behaviors: choosing grasps for later assembly, using surrounding geometry to reorient parts, and preparing one part, assembling another, then returning to finish the first without an explicit planner. For videos, see our website: this https URL

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: In Deep Reinforcement Learning for Robotics, we study how policies acquire reliable behavior when actions involve contact, precision, and long sequences. Today's lecture is on AlphaNIST. On the N-I-S-T Assembly Task Board, a robot must fit small parts together, sometimes while other parts obstruct its work. The challenge is not just a careful insertion; it is learning what to do without being handed a sequence of prescribed maneuvers. Yes, Noah?
segments.zh: 在机器人深度强化学习中，我们研究的是当动作涉及接触、精度和长序列时，策略如何获得可靠的行为。今天的讲座讲的是AlphaNIST。在NIST装配任务板上，机器人必须把小的零件拼装在一起，有时还有其他零件挡住它的工作。挑战不只是小心翼翼地插入，而是在没有被给定一系列规定动作的情况下，学会该怎么做。好，Noah？

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Hi Professor, is the key idea that one policy practices across different assembly tasks instead of learning each one separately?
segments.zh: 教授您好，关键思路是不是用一个策略在多个不同的装配任务上练习，而不是每个任务单独学一个策略？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: That is the central idea, with an important qualification about the objective. Recent work such as A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control studies how to distribute practice across starting states. Emergent Dexterity via Diverse Resets and Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning explores broad reset coverage for manipulation. AlphaNIST brings related ingredients to varied assemblies and asks whether shared experience under a common completion objective can help. That matters because assembly is difficult to learn from sparse feedback.
segments.zh: 这就是核心思想，不过关于目标函数还有一个重要的限定。近期一些工作，比如《A Balanced Data Diet: Addressing the Exploration Bottleneck in Mega-Scale RL for Robot Control》，研究了如何在不同的起始状态之间分配练习。而《Emergent Dexterity via Diverse Resets and Large-Scale Reinforcement Learning》则探索了在操作任务中实现广泛的重置覆盖。AlphaNIST 把相关的要素带到了各种不同的装配任务中，并追问：在共同的完成目标下，共享经验是否能有所帮助。这一点很重要，因为装配任务很难从稀疏反馈中学习。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The paper trains one shared policy across 20 different assembly pairs, rather than giving every pair its own policy. Its task reward signals whether an assembly is complete, not how much intermediate progress has been made. The result is strikingly high training success under that setup: 98.2% averaged across the 20 tasks. But this is not a claim that the policy assembles all 20 pairs in one episode; those are separate single-pair tasks.
segments.zh: 这篇论文在20个不同的装配任务对上训练同一个共享策略，而不是给每个任务对单独配一个策略。它的任务奖励只表示装配是否完成，并不反映中间进展了多少。结果在这种设定下训练成功率出奇地高：20个任务平均达到98.2%。但这并不是说策略能在一次回合里装配完所有20个任务对；那些是各自独立的单任务对任务。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Quick question: if the task reward only marks completion, does the policy receive no other reward at all?
segments.zh: 问个快问题：如果任务奖励只标记完成，那策略就完全收不到其他奖励了吗？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: It does receive another term: a per-step control cost. So “binary task reward” describes the assembly objective, not the whole reward function. The completion signal arrives when the part is within 0.001 meters of its fully assembled pose; intermediate progress earns no task reward. A useful analogy is grading a final solution rather than awarding points for each intermediate step, while still charging a small cost for the effort spent along the way.
segments.zh: 它确实还会收到另一项：每步的控制成本。所以“二元任务奖励”描述的是装配目标，而不是整个奖励函数。完成信号在零件距离完全装配姿态0.001米以内时才会出现；中间进展不会获得任何任务奖励。一个有用的类比是：只给最终答案打分，而不是给每个中间步骤都加分，但同时仍然会为沿途付出的努力收取一点小成本。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The training process also varies where the robot starts. A cache contains assembly identities and reset states ranging from loose parts to pickup and transport situations, near-mating positions, and partial assemblies. Success-guided sampling gives more practice to states where the current policy succeeds about half the time, while preserving a chance to sample every cached state. These are alternative training starting points, not a scripted sequence the robot must follow.
segments.zh: 训练过程还会改变机器人的起始状态。缓存里存有装配体标识和重置状态，涵盖从散落零件到抓取与搬运场景、接近对接位置以及部分装配完成的情况。成功引导采样会让当前策略成功率大约一半的状态获得更多练习机会，同时保留对每个缓存状态进行采样的可能性。这些是备选的训练起点，而不是机器人必须遵循的预设序列。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Can you clarify how the policy knows which assembly it is facing if it has no task ID?
segments.zh: 那如果策略没有任务ID，它怎么知道当前面对的是哪个装配任务呢？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The policy receives geometry point clouds and robot state, rather than a discrete task label. It must use the observed scene to respond to the particular parts and their positions. Across 64,000 simulated environments and 25,000 iterations, the shared sparse-reward policy reached 98.2% success, with a reported variation of 0.986 percentage points. It exceeded 98% on every task, while 20 separately trained policies averaged 81.4%.
segments.zh: 策略接收的是几何点云和机器人状态，而不是离散的任务标签。它必须根据观察到的场景来应对特定的零件及其位置。在64000个模拟环境和25000次迭代中，共享稀疏奖励策略达到了98.2%的成功率，报告的波动为0.986个百分点。它在每个任务上都超过了98%，而20个单独训练的策略平均只有81.4%。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The comparison is not simply “sharing wins.” The experiment also changes the reward. With dense shaping that rewards end-effector proximity and orientation alignment, each weighted 0.01, the shared policy reached 17.8%, while separate policies averaged 78.3%. These are training success rates under the same scale and iteration setup. The four-way comparison shows that both the sharing arrangement and the reward formulation matter; it does not isolate task sharing as the only cause.
segments.zh: 这个对比并不是简单地说“共享就一定赢”。实验同时还改了奖励。在密集塑形奖励下，也就是对末端执行器接近目标和姿态对齐分别给0.01的权重，共享策略只达到17.8%，而单独训练的策略平均达到78.3%。这些都是在相同规模和迭代设置下的训练成功率。这个四组对比说明，共享安排和奖励设计都很重要；它并没有把任务共享单独分离出来作为唯一原因。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: So the shared policy’s advantage depends on sparse feedback, but do the authors establish why dense shaping hurts it?
segments.zh: 所以共享策略的优势依赖于稀疏反馈，但作者有没有解释清楚为什么密集塑形反而对它不利？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: No. The authors suggest that a common completion objective may be more consistent across different geometries, whereas dense shaping can favor different partial solutions. That is an interpretation, not a uniquely demonstrated mechanism. There is also a compute comparison: the shared sparse-reward run used 410 device-hours, while the 20 specialist runs used 16,100 total, or 39.3 times as many. This compares device-hours, not elapsed time, attempts, or action counts.
segments.zh: 没有。作者认为，一个通用的完成目标可能在不同几何形状之间更一致，而密集塑形则可能偏向不同的部分解。这是一种解释，并不是唯一被证明的机制。还有一个计算量对比：共享的稀疏奖励运行用了410设备小时，而20个专家运行总共用了16100小时，是前者的39.3倍。这里比较的是设备小时，不是实际耗时、尝试次数或动作数量。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: A separate evaluation asks whether smarter reset selection helps. At 256,000 environments, beta sampling achieved 97.4% success, compared with 84.3% for uniform reset sampling. Here the policies were evaluated stochastically on a common frozen bank of mixed resets, with 32 trials per task per seed, 20 tasks, and five evaluation seeds. Success required full assembly within 15 seconds without a simultaneous safety failure. These evaluation figures should not be confused with the training comparison.
segments.zh: 另有一项独立评估考察更智能的重置选择是否有帮助。在256,000个环境下，beta采样达到了97.4%的成功率，而均匀重置采样为84.3%。这里的策略是在一个共同的冻结混合重置库上进行随机评估的，每个任务每个种子32次试验，共20个任务，5个评估种子。成功要求在15秒内完成完整装配，且不能同时出现安全故障。这些评估数据不应与训练时的比较混为一谈。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: Does the paper also test whether one policy can manage several assemblies in the same episode?
segments.zh: 论文是否也测试了同一个策略能否在同一个回合里管理多个装配任务？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Yes, using a separately trained multi-pair policy configuration, distinct from the 20-task single-pair policy. Its reward remains zero until every active pair is assembled, with no prescribed order or intermediate completion reward; episodes allow 15 seconds per pair. Success is 99% with one active pair and 84% with ten. In an observed sequence, the robot moves a U-S-B A connector closer, leaves it to assemble a rod, then returns to insert the connector.
segments.zh: 是的，他们用了一个单独训练的多对策略配置，和那个20任务的单对策略不一样。它的奖励只有在所有活跃的配对都组装完成后才不再是零，没有规定顺序，也没有中间完成奖励；每个配对给15秒。一个活跃配对时成功率是99%，十个活跃配对时是84%。在一次观察到的序列里，机器人先把一个USB A连接器移近，然后放下它去组装一根杆，之后再回来插入那个连接器。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: Another sequence shows the robot making small turns while threading an M12 nut near an R-J-45 connector. The authors describe this behavior as planning-like: the policy appears to defer one subtask and avoid interference while completing another. That is evidence of coordination in this setting, not proof of a general planner. All reported results are in simulation, and the paper does not establish hardware transfer or completion of all 20 pairs in one episode.
segments.zh: 另一段序列显示，机器人在靠近RJ45连接器的地方拧M12螺母时做了小幅转动。作者把这种行为描述为类规划：策略似乎会推迟一个子任务，并在完成另一个子任务时避免干扰。这在该设定下是协调能力的证据，并不能证明它具备通用规划器。所有报告的结果都来自仿真，论文并未证明能迁移到硬件，也未证明能在单次轨迹中完成全部20对。

segments.speaker: Noah
segments.en: How does this fit with the earlier reset and sampling work you mentioned, and what remains uncertain?
segments.zh: 这和前面提到的重置与采样工作有什么关系，还有哪些地方仍不确定？

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: AlphaNIST extends rather than invents diverse resets or success-guided sampling. Its contribution is to apply these ideas across heterogeneous assemblies under a shared sparse completion objective. The contrast with earlier sampling work is especially useful: changing how experience is allocated is not, by itself, the full story, because the dense-reward shared policy performs poorly in this comparison. Whether the same combination transfers to physical contact, imperfect perception, or different assembly families remains open.
segments.zh: AlphaNIST 并不是发明了多样化的重置或成功引导的采样，而是对它们做了扩展。它的贡献在于，把这些思路应用到了异构装配任务上，并共享一个稀疏的完成目标。和早期采样工作的对比尤其有启发：改变经验的分配方式本身并不是全部，因为在这个对比中，密集奖励的共享策略表现很差。同样的组合能否迁移到物理接触、不完美的感知，或者不同的装配任务族，仍然是个开放问题。

segments.speaker: John
segments.en: The broader lesson is that varied practice can teach a robot useful contact skills and sequencing behavior without specifying each maneuver or the order of tasks. In these experiments, that result depends on the shared policy, the reset strategy, and especially the completion-focused task objective. The evidence invites further tests beyond simulation, while keeping clear what has actually been demonstrated. Thanks for listening. If you have any further questions, ask our AI assistant or drop a comment.
segments.zh: 更广泛的启示是，多样化的练习可以让机器人学会有用的接触技能和任务排序行为，而不需要明确指定每个动作或任务顺序。在这些实验中，这一结果依赖于共享策略、重置策略，尤其是以完成为核心的任务目标。这些证据值得在仿真之外做进一步测试，同时也要清楚目前实际证明了什么。感谢收听。如果还有问题，可以问我们的AI助手，或者留言评论。
